SUPERIOR COURT OF NEW JERSEY
CAPE MAY COUNTY SUPERIOR COURT
SHERIFF'S SALE NO. 26000096
DOCKET NO. F-010849-25
PLAINTIFF – “U.S. BANK TRUST NATIONAL ASSOCIATION AS TRUSTEE FOR IGLOO SERIES IV TRUST”
DEFENDANTS- “KENNETH PHILLIPS, JR.; PALMETTO SOLAR, LLC DBA LIGHTREACH;”
By virtue of the above stated Writ of Execution to me directed and delivered I will expose for sale at public venue on
Wednesday THE 10th DAY OF June 2026
At 1:00 o'clock in the afternoon at the old Courthouse building located at 9 N Main Street (Route 9), in Cape May Court House, New Jersey to wit:
All that tract or parcel of land, situate, lying and being in the TOWNSHIP OF DENNIS of, County of Cape May and State of New Jersey:
Being known as: LOT 30, BLOCK 70
Nearest Cross Street: Hall Avenue
GOOD FAITH ESTIMATED UPSET PRICE: $355,868.28
PREMISES COMMONLY KNOWN AS:
684 PETERSBURG Road Dennisville, NJ 08214
A more complete metes and bounds description can be found in the Office of the Cape May County Sheriff.
Lien(s)/Taxes:
Tax Certificate Recorded: October 7, 2025. Holder: American Tax Lien Fund LLC, Amount $2,112.25, Book: M6844, page 979, Instrument Number: Cert. No: 25-00014
Note: The street address is merely given as a convenience to the bidders and is not a representation of fact on the part of the sheriff. The diagram or concise description does not constitute a full legal description of the premises, but it can be found in the Cape May County Sheriff Office.
Subject to any unpaid taxes, municipal liens or other charges, and any such taxes, charges, liens, insurance premiums or other advances made by plaintiff prior to this sale. All interested parties are to conduct and rely upon their own independent investigation to ascertain whether or not any outstanding interest remain of record and/or have priority over the lien being foreclosed and, if so the current amount due thereon.
If the sale is set aside for any reason, the Purchaser at the sale shall be entitled only to a return of the deposit paid. The Purchaser shall have no further recourse against the Mortgagor, the Mortgagee and the Mortgagee’s attorney.
Surplus Money: If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any. The approximate amount due on this execution is $329,135.19 plus interest, cost, printers’ fees, Sheriff's fees and commission. The prior liens, as per affidavit of consideration are not a representation of fact on the part of the Sheriff.
Robert A. Nolan, SHERIFF
DATED: March 16, 2026
Friedman Vartolo, LLP
1325 Franklin Avenue
Suite 160
Garden City, NY 11530
212-471-5100
